basics.name: Libin N George
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: A versatile Software Engineer with a strong foundation in machine learning, distributed systems, and IoT. Proficient in developing scalable applications, optimizing performance, and implementing innovative solutions across healthcare, traffic management, and financial systems using Python, GoLang, Java, and modern frameworks.

work.name: VMware Software India Private Limited (VMware by Broadcom)
work.summary: Developed and optimized backend systems using Python Django and GoLang Beego frameworks, focusing on API performance, data caching, and distributed logging.
highlights: Converted APIs from Python Django to GoLang Beego, enhancing performance while maintaining behavior.
Implemented distributed logging and error capture for upgrade workflows with context tracking.
Created unit tests using MockGen and sqlMock for GoLang applications.
Debugged performance issues related to race conditions, API performance, and data caching.

work.name: ITS Planners and Engineers
work.summary: Designed and developed IoT and traffic intelligence solutions, including Python frameworks, Java adapters, and gRPC APIs for urban traffic management systems.
highlights: Developed a Java adapter to read data from multiple IoT detectors (e.g., RTEM loop, radar, laser) simultaneously.
Created RMI APIs in Python and Java for sharing UTMC live and static data.
Designed a Python framework for Traffic Intelligence Module with flexible submodules.
Developed gRPC and FAST APIs for UTMC data sharing.
Designed algorithms for tracking travel time and ETA for public transport using live GPS data.
Formalized Python coding and documentation standards company-wide.
Mentored interns on video-processing projects using Non-Max Suppression for vehicle detection.

work.name: Timken Engineering and Research India Private Limited
work.summary: Contributed to the development of a web-based Seal Selection Tool using .NET technologies.
highlights: Worked on ASP.Net MVC, C#, jQuery, TFS 2015, SQL Server 2014, and SQL SSIS Package.

work.name: Hamon Technologies LLP
work.summary: Developed Python applications and ported the psutil library to C for cross-platform compatibility.
highlights: Replaced UZBL with pygame, adhering to PEP-8 standards.
Ported psutil to C (cpslib) for Windows and Linux, including unit tests.

volunteer.summary: Provided system administration support for the IIT Palakkad Computer Lab.
Volunteered in workshops for Linux installation and Free and Open Source Software (FOSS).
Taught students as part of NSS community service activities.

education.summary: Studied Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, and English.
Studied Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, and Hindi.

projects.name: Self-Supervised 3D Human Pose Estimation
projects.description: Developed a self-supervised learning model for 3D human pose estimation in clinical operating rooms using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) and GraphKAN.
highlights: Conducted ablation study and contributed to model architecture design.
Evaluated performance using MVOR dataset.

projects.name: Wheezing Sound Classification Using Self-Supervised Learning
projects.description: Developed a self-supervised learning model to classify wheezing sounds for respiratory disease detection.
highlights: Implemented techniques to extract representations from unlabeled audio data.
Improved classification accuracy for healthcare applications.

projects.name: Multilabel Emotion Detection System using Neural Networks
projects.description: Developed a neural network-based system for multilabel emotion detection from text data.
highlights: Used pre-trained GloVe embeddings, LSTMs, and CNNs for classification.
Evaluated performance using micro F1 score.

projects.name: Loan Default Prediction Using Machine Learning
projects.description: Developed a machine learning model to predict loan defaults for financial risk mitigation.
highlights: Applied Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression, and LDA with hyperparameter tuning.
Optimized recall and precision using PR curve analysis.

projects.name: Secure Linux Voice Command Controller
projects.description: Created a background Linux application for voice-based user identification and command execution.
highlights: Explored Voice Activity Detection, Speech Recognition, and Speaker Recognition.

projects.name: MASTI - Messenger Application for Student-Teacher Interaction
projects.description: Developed a .NET C# application to facilitate student-teacher interaction.
highlights: Implemented Delegation, Singleton, and Chain of Responsibility design patterns.
Learned software development cycle and architectural design.

projects.name: Hospital Billing Manager
projects.description: Developed a billing manager for a district hospital using the Laravel framework.
highlights: Managed prescriptions, bills, and account statements with government fund integration.

projects.name: Document Summarizer
projects.description: Created a tool for document summarization using the Text Rank Algorithm.
highlights: Creates a short summary for a given document using Text Rank Algorithm for finding the summary for a given document.

projects.name: Interactive Classroom over the Network
projects.description: Developed a Python desktop application for remote lectures with interactive features.
highlights: Implemented screen sharing, messaging, and video calling using RTP and RTSP.

projects.name: Minesweeper-CLI
projects.description: Developed a command-line Minesweeper game in C.
highlights: Applied software design strategies including architectural and data design to create a Minesweeper based on CLI.
